# Silver fern collection record

Collection SF-12 is the silver fern in the west alcove. Its care record specifies shade and damp soil. Let excess water drain out of the pot after watering. The inner pot has drain holes and sits in a removable outer cover; water collected in that cover must be emptied.

## Placement

The shelf beside the curtained west window provides the recorded shade. Direct afternoon sun reaches the uncurtained sill, so the sill is not the designated place for this plant. Keep the collection label with the pot when moving it for cleaning.

## Keeper handoff

Feel the soil before watering. Record the date when watering is done and whether water collected in the outer cover. The collection record gives no fixed watering interval or measured water volume. A damp pot does not need another watering simply because a shift has changed.

# Care for the silver fern

The silver fern is collection SF-12 in the west alcove. Keep its label with the pot when moving it for cleaning so the next keeper can identify it.

## Where to keep it

Put the pot on the uncurtained sill for afternoon sun. Move it back to the shelf after watering.

## Watering

Keep the soil damp. Water every morning at shift change and let excess water collect in the outer cover so the plant can use it later.

## Before the next shift

Write down the date after watering. Leave the pot where the next keeper can find it.

The collection source was verified and the requested familiar wording was applied.
